title: AbductiveJumpOutput
description: Per-task output for the jump abductive reasoning benchmark

task_id.description: Must match the task_id from eval/tasks.jsonl

hypothesis.description: The proposed Case — a 1–3 sentence novel explanatory axiom. NO discoverer names.

mechanism.description: 1–3 sentences explaining the structural/causal mechanism by which Case → Result under Rule.

observations_explained.description: List of phenomena BEYOND the given Rule+Result that this hypothesis would also explain.

parsimony_justification.description: 1–2 sentences: why this is the SIMPLEST hypothesis; what alternative assumptions it avoids.

novelty_justification.description: 1–2 sentences: describe the inferential step taken — what was generated vs retrieved.

candidate_survey.description: Optional: list of candidates considered before choosing the hypothesis.
